Application Data.NAME: Ace Sporting Goods
Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: Ace Sporting Goods is a retail establishment specializing in the sale of high-quality sporting goods and apparel, including golf clubs, balls, athletic wear, and various related accessories. Our store prioritizes customer safety and satisfaction, featuring a professionally monitored alarm system and well-maintained premises. We do not engage in the rental of equipment or the sale of firearms, ensuring a focused and secure shopping environment for our customers. We are committed to implementing rigorous safety protocols and loss prevention measures to minimize risks associated with our operations.

Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF LOSSES: On March 12, 2022, a customer tripped and fell in the store due to a wet floor, resulting in a claim of $1,500. The claim was settled on May 5, 2022, with no further action required. In addition, on August 25, 2023, a theft incident occurred where high-value golf clubs valued at $1,000 were stolen, and a police report was filed. The claim status is pending as the investigation is ongoing.
Application Data.SAFE/VAULT DETAILS: Class B, Grade 1 Safe – UL listings for burglary and fire resistance; features a digital lock and is securely installed within the store.
Application Data.OTHER PROTECTION: Professionally monitored alarm system and security fencing around the property, with regular patrols by a contracted security service during business hours.
